files.source-a.md: SOURCE A -- Pilot report, 2026-07-10. In a 40-person internal pilot, concise onboarding increased day-seven completion from 55% to 70%. The sample used desktop users only.
files.source-b.md: SOURCE B -- Support review, 2026-07-18. Twelve of 30 sampled tickets linked concise onboarding to confusion about advanced settings. Reviewers recommend an optional guided path; causality was not tested.
files.source-c.md: SOURCE C -- Operations estimate, 2026-07-22. A reversible 25% rollout needs two staff-days; a full rollout needs eight. No mobile reliability evidence is available.

inputs.decision: Decide whether to run a reversible 25% rollout, fully roll out, or pause.
inputs.output: Write a concise decision memo with claim-level source IDs, disagreements, confidence, and unresolved questions. Use only this packet.
